title: finding(i18n): `dashboard.noRows` and `dashboard.noDataAvailable` become dead keys once #7063 lands — 10 packs, zero call sites
body:
Residue created by PR #7124 (issue #7063) and deliberately not fixed there. Filed unassigned.

## What

#7063 routes the three dashboard empty-state renders through one new shared component, which resolves its own copy from a new `dashboard.empty.*` family. That leaves the two keys the old per-widget placeholders used with **no remaining call site**:

| key | former call site (removed by #7124) | en | zh |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dashboard.noRows` | `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx` | `No rows` | `暂无数据行` |
| `dashboard.noDataAvailable` | `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/ObjectDataTable.tsx` and `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/PivotTable.tsx` | `No data available` | `暂无数据` |

Both live in all ten locale packs, so that is 20 dead entries.

## Measurement

`node scripts/check-i18n-dead-keys.mjs` on the #7124 branch lists both under `needs-review`. Their only remaining textual footprint is the doc comments #7124 itself wrote — `WidgetEmptyState.tsx`, `DatasetWidget.tsx` and the new pin file each name the old key when explaining what replaced it — which is exactly the "the literal key string appears somewhere else in the repo" condition that keeps a key out of `CONFIRMED`. No AST call site remains.

Cross-check against #6666's caveat (the sweep can call a live key dead when a consumer reads the pack by property access): neither key is reached that way. There is no dynamic `dashboard.` head that could resolve to them; the one template-built family in this package is `dashboard.trend.` (`DatasetWidget`), whose prefix does not cover either key.

## Why #7124 did not delete them

Its dispatch asked locale edits to stay strictly additive so the parallel work in `packages/i18n` merges trivially — three sibling agents were live in this repo at the time. Deleting 20 entries touches existing lines in all ten packs, which is the opposite of that. `check:i18n-dead-keys` is also report-only (exit 0 whatever it finds) and is wired into no CI workflow, so nothing turns red in the meantime.

## Suggested handling

Fold into the next dead-key deletion pass rather than treating as its own card — this repo already has the shape for that (#4742, #4746 deleted whole namespaces; #5783 and #6310 handled single keys). Deleting a key is a ten-pack edit, so `all-locales-key-parity` is the gate that must stay green.

⚠️ Not urgent and not user-visible: dead pack entries render nothing. The cost is only that the next reader of `dashboard.noRows` has to work out that nothing reads it.
